title: rosa × dumetorum suboxyphylla
intro: Rosa × dumetorum suboxyphylla, commonly known as Wild Roses, is a species of rose plant that is a hybrid of Rosa dumetorum and Rosa oxyphylla. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum suboxyphylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
